parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The quicksort implementation filters out pivot elements, causing them to be lost. We need to include elements equal to the pivot in both the lesser and greater partitions.

modifications.anchor: lesser = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x < pivot])

modifications.anchor: greater = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x > pivot])
